# Real Elite Contracting

Premium design-build remodeler for kitchens, primary suites, basements and lower levels, additions, decks, and outdoor living. Serving West Virginia, Virginia, Maryland, and Pennsylvania.

Family-run by brothers Jose and Miguel. Miguel is a U.S. military veteran and Purple Heart recipient. No federal veteran certification is held. There is no publicly published founding date, and the company does not display fabricated review ratings: star/aggregate ratings appear only when mirrored from the verified Google Business Profile.

The homepage describes design-build remodeling for Loudoun homes: kitchens, primary suites, lower levels, additions and outdoor living for Leesburg, Ashburn, Middleburg and Hunt Country.

## Contact

- Phone: (681) 534-5515
- Email: info@realelitecontracting.com
- Base: Martinsburg, WV 25405 (Eastern Panhandle)
- Hours: Mon–Fri: 7:00 AM – 6:00 PM | Sat: 8:00 AM – 2:00 PM
- The call and the first site visit are at no charge. They exist to decide, on both sides, whether the project is a fit before anyone commits to a design phase.
- Free written estimates.
- Contact: https://www.realelitecontracting.com/contact
- Contact markdown: https://www.realelitecontracting.com/contact.md

## Services

- Bathroom Remodeling. Walk-in showers, tile work, vanities, and full master-bath transformations across the WV–MD–VA region. https://www.realelitecontracting.com/services/bathrooms Markdown: https://www.realelitecontracting.com/services/bathrooms.md
- Kitchen Remodeling. Custom cabinetry, islands, layout changes, and full kitchen transformations. Premium kitchens for families who actually cook. https://www.realelitecontracting.com/services/kitchens Markdown: https://www.realelitecontracting.com/services/kitchens.md
- Basement Finishing. Finished family rooms, in-law suites, basement bars. Done to code with proper moisture control. https://www.realelitecontracting.com/services/basements Markdown: https://www.realelitecontracting.com/services/basements.md
- Whole-Home Remodeling. Interior and exterior remodels — kitchens, bathrooms, basements, and full home renovations with a coordinated scope. https://www.realelitecontracting.com/services/remodeling
- Decks. Composite and pressure-treated decks, railings, and built-ins using premium materials. https://www.realelitecontracting.com/services/decks Markdown: https://www.realelitecontracting.com/services/decks.md
- Outdoor Living. Screened porches, covered patios, pergolas, and outdoor living spaces tied into the house. https://www.realelitecontracting.com/services/outdoor-living Markdown: https://www.realelitecontracting.com/services/outdoor-living.md
- Stairs & Railings. Staircase remodels, new treads and balusters, handrails, and deck and porch stairs built to code. https://www.realelitecontracting.com/services/stairs
- Roofing. Architectural shingle replacement, valley flashing, storm-damage repair, and complete tear-offs. https://www.realelitecontracting.com/services/roofing
- Siding & Stone Exteriors. Vinyl, fiber cement, and stone veneer that elevates every facade — the highest-ROI exterior upgrade. https://www.realelitecontracting.com/services/siding
- Paving & Seal Coating. Driveways, parking lots, repairs, and seal coating — asphalt, concrete, and tar-and-chip — across the Eastern Panhandle. https://www.realelitecontracting.com/paving
- Home Additions. Bump-outs, single rooms, second stories, and in-law suites — engineered to look like they were always part of the home. https://www.realelitecontracting.com/services/additions Markdown: https://www.realelitecontracting.com/services/additions.md

## Service areas

West Virginia, Virginia, Maryland, and Pennsylvania. Maryland is in the service area. Headquarters are in Martinsburg, WV.

- West Virginia: Martinsburg, Inwood, Charles Town, Ranson, Hedgesville, Spring Mills, Falling Waters, Berkeley Springs, Shepherdstown, Harpers Ferry, Kearneysville, Bunker Hill.
- Maryland, fully in the service area: Frederick, Monrovia, Ijamsville, New Market, Urbana, Mount Airy, Middletown, Adamstown, Point of Rocks, Brunswick, Hagerstown, Boonsboro, Sharpsburg, Williamsport, Garrett Park, Bethesda, Potomac, Cabin John, West Friendship, Chevy Chase, Glenwood, Clarksville, Brookeville, Kensington, Woodbine, Dickerson, Marriottsville, Ellicott City, Laytonsville, Barnesville, Olney, Ashton, North Potomac, Rockville, Derwood, Colesville, Takoma Park, Columbia, Silver Spring, Aspen Hill, Myersville, Montgomery County, Howard County.
- Virginia: Winchester, Leesburg, Ashburn, McLean, Alexandria, Vienna, Great Falls, Reston, Burke, Fairfax Station, Clifton, Middleburg, Loudoun County, Brambleton, Northern Virginia, Purcellville, Round Hill, Lovettsville, Waterford, Hamilton, Aldie, Lansdowne, South Riding, Sterling, Fairfax County, Prince William County, Oakton, Dunn Loring, Fort Hunt, Haymarket, Gainesville, Bristow, Nokesville, Springfield, Chantilly, Centreville, Falls Church, Fairfax, Manassas, Lake Ridge, Woodbridge, Warrenton, Berryville, The Plains, Upperville, Marshall, Arlington, Catharpin, Broad Run, Delaplane, Annandale, Bluemont.
- Pennsylvania: Greencastle, Chambersburg, Fort Loudon, Mercersburg, Waynesboro, Fayetteville.
